verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents built-in tracing and a Traces dashboard for debugging and monitoring, plus guardrails for input/output validation. It does not document any built-in eval or scoring capability, or any CI integration for running evals. Tracing and guardrails are adjacent observability and validation features, not agent-quality evals, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can score agent quality with built-in evals and run them as part of CI
